include_daily_rollout.description: Online serving | Add a paused daily traffic rollout job? Uses an explicitly initialized rollout, verified monitoring, 10 percentage-point stages lasting at least 24 hours, and guarded champion promotion after the final stage passes. Configure config/serving.yml before enabling.

include_online_serving.description: Online features | Add explicit online endpoint setup and saved freshness policy configuration? Independent of publication and rollout. Requires pandas, non-temporal lookup and single-model or competition training. Configure training.yml and serving.yml before running.

include_online_publication.description: Online features | Add explicit native publication controls? Publishes one selected latest-value Delta feature table into an existing online store. Independent of online serving and rollout. Configure config/serving.yml before enabling.

online_publication_mode.description: Online features | Publication mode? TRIGGERED adds a paused hourly sync; CONTINUOUS adds explicit start/status/stop/restart controls with no periodic schedule.

serving_logging_mode.description: Online features | Endpoint inference table: telemetry = log every REST and ai_query request (needed for rollout and serving monitoring); ai_gateway = the same where your workspace supports AI Gateway tables; disabled = no inference table, callers store predictions themselves

serving_logging_table_prefix.description: Online features | Inference table name prefix in the project catalog and schema; Databricks writes <prefix>_payload. Blank uses <project_name>_endpoint
